**Author:** The Milk Man (@MrMilkTrading) · posted 2026-08-30 · received 2026-08-30T07:07:34Z

## Summary
Full spec of the dip-buy system, stated as "exactly as tested" (backtest stats in attached media, not accessible via oembed):

1. **Signal:** RSI(2) on daily closes
2. **Entry:** buy the close when RSI(2) < 10 **and** price > 200-day SMA
3. **Exit:** sell the close when RSI(2) > 70, **or after 10 sessions**, whichever comes first
4. **Long only.** ES and NQ, 1 contract each. **No stop.**

## Why it matters
- Classic Connors-style short-term mean-reversion: extreme oversold *inside* a long-term uptrend (200-SMA filter), time-boxed exit — the 10-session cap and RSI>70 are the whole risk management; there is deliberately no stop.
- Completes a third leg in the Milk Man ecosystem alongside the options variant and the NQ replication — same author, different strategy family (mean-reversion vs. the trend/replication notes below).
- Fully specified → directly replicable; the missing piece is the attached backtest stats (task created to view them).
